# GetUDPMsgAddress

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetUDPMsgAddress:String udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of the sender of the last message that [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) received, as text, or an empty string before the first message. Use it instead of [UDPMsgIP](UDPMsgIP) when the sender may use IPv6, as that returns 0 for these.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Not in the original, which only knows IPv4. See [IPv6](IPv6).
